snippet.title: Legionbound Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Legionbound is coming out on April 27th 2026!

Check the game out on Steam and add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4283360/Legionbound/

Legionbound is a casual retro party-based RPG with autobattler combat. Recruit and lead a large band of heroes, encounter new challenges each run, and build lasting power through roguelite progression and powerful synergy classes!
